senses.gloss:
m. (-यः)
1 A species of ox, the Gayal, erroneously classed by Hindu writers amongst the kinds of deer, (Bos gavaeus.)
2 A monkey chief: the son of VAIVASVATA.
f. (-यी)
The female Gayal.
E.
गु to sound, and अय affix, form irregular; or गो a cow, and य from या to obtain, affix ड, resembling a cow.

m. (-जः)
A bull.
E.
गो a cow, affix अण्, गव relating to a cow, and राजन् king, chief; the more direct compound makes गोराज.

m. (-लः)
A wild buffalo.
n. (-लं)
Buffalo's horn.
E.
गु to sound, अलच् aff.

m. (-क्षः)
1 An air hole, a loop hole, a round window, a bull's eye, &c.
2 A monkey chief; one of the sons of VAIVASVATA.
E.
गो a ray of light, अक्ष to spread, affix घञ्, or गो an ox, and अक्ष an eye; ox-eyed.
f. (-क्षी)
A sort of cucumber, (Cucumis madraspatanus.)
2 A plant, (Clitoria ternatea): see अपराजिता.
E.
गो the earth, अक्ष to spread, affixes अण् and ङीप्.

n. (-लं)
A lattice, a jealousie, trellis-work^1.
E.
गवाक्ष, and जाल a net.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar on 20210731. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/66.

f. (-ची)
A fish, (Macrognathus pancalus.)

n. (-नं)
Pasture or meadow grass.
f. (-नी)
1 A hay rack, a trough for holding grass out of which cattle feed.
2 A species of cucumber, (Cucumis madraspatanus, or, according to some, C. coloquintida.)
3 A plant, (Clitoria ternatea): see the preceding.
E.
गो a cow, अदन food, fem. affix ङीप्.

m. (-कः)
The Gayal, (Bos gavaeus): see गवय.
E.
गो a cow, लोक to see, with आङ् prefixed, deriv. irr; in appearance a cow.

m. (-नः)
An outcaste.
E.
गव, and अशन who eats, eating beef.

f. (-का)
Lac, the dye.

n. (-कं)
A day's feed for a cow.
E.
गो, and अह्निक daily.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Owner of kine.
E.
गो a cow, ईश्वर a lord or master.

m. (-डुः)
A cloud.
f. (-डुः)
A kind of grain, (Coix barbata.)
E.
गो a cow or the earth, ण्ड to preserve, उ affix, or with कन् added गवेडुका; also गवेधु, &c.

f. (-धुः)
Coix barbata: see the preceding; also with कन् added गवेधुका.

n. (-कं)
Red chalk.
E.
गो light or colour, ईर to send, affix वुन्, and the penultimate changed to उ irregularly; also read गवेधुक.

f. (-का)
A plant, (Hedysarum lagopodioides.)

r. 10th cl. (गवेषयति)
1 To seek, to hunt for, to search or inquire.
2 To make an effort.

nf. (-णं-णा)
Research, inquiry after any thing, (physical or philosophical, &c.)
E.
गवेष to inquire, affix युच्.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Sought, inquired for.
E.
गवेष to search or hunt, affix क्त.

m. (-द्घः)
An excellent cow.
E.
गो a cow, and उद्घ implying excellence; the compound remains masculine.

mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं)
1 (Of or belonging to a cow, as milk, curds, &c.)
2 Proper or fit for cattle.
nf. (-व्यं-व्या)
A bowstring.
f. (-व्या)
1 A multitude of cows.
2 A measure of two Kos: see गव्यूति.
n. (-व्यं)
A colouring substance, a yellow pigment or dye.
E.
गो a cow, &c. and यत् aff.

nf. (-तं)
1 A Kos, a measure of length equal to 4000 cubits.
2 A measure of two Kos: see the next.

mf. (-तिः)
A measure of two Kos, a league measured by 2000 Dands or fathoms.
E.
गो the earth, यु to join, क्तिन् affix, deriv. irr.
